response: Discharging patients earlier from Winnipeg hospitals does not appear to adversely affect the quality of care. Research has shown that shortening the length of stay in hospitals does not result in increased rates of readmission or numbers of physician visits within 30 days after discharge. However, it is essential to identify optimal lengths of stay and expected readmission rates to ensure that patients receive the best possible care. Additionally, other factors such as the introduction of a dedicated discharge coordinator can improve the quality of discharge planning, but may come at an additional cost. Overall, the goal is to strike a balance between efficient hospital operations and high-quality patient care.
